Token Update First Use Acceptance Flag: Identifies Token Update First Use Acceptance Flag from merchant (Sub Table ID 24).

Merchant Tran ID Acceptance Flag: Sub-Table 25 flag indicating merchant can accept Merchant Tran ID in response.
Transaction Link Action Support Indicator: Sub-Table 26 flag indicating Transaction Link Action Indicators desired in response.
Sub-Table Data (Sub-Table ID 27): Flag indicating merchant can accept Applied Special Service Data from Visa.
Sub-Table Data (Sub-Table ID 28): Flag indicating merchant can accept Voyager Restriction Codes in response.
Visa Category Code Support Indicator (Sub-Table ID 30): Flag indicating Visa Category Codes are desired in response.
Sub-Table Data (Visa Category Code Support Indicator): Indicates Visa Category Code will be returned in transaction response.
Additional Security Code: Indicates if additional security code sent from terminal, variable length 1-16 bytes.

Sub-Table Data (KSN): KSN information sub-table, variable length up to 40 bytes, under Sub-Table ID 01.
Sub-Table Data (Device Type): Device type information sub-table, variable length up to 8 bytes, under Sub-Table ID 02.

Merchant Tran ID: Table ID 054; value assigned by merchant to identify the transaction.
Experience Provider Value: Table ID 055; value received from UCOM for each Experience Provider.
Table ID (056): Fixed value 056 identifying Stored Credentials Transaction Additional Data table.
Table Length: Variable length field up to 200 bytes for stored credentials table.
Table Data: Contains additional data for MIT and CIT transactions, max length 200.
Sub-Table ID: Sub-table identifier, valid values 01-24.

Sub-Table Length: Sub-table length field, valid values 01-35.
Sub-Table Data: Sub-table data field, maximum length 35 bytes.
Sub-Table ID '01' Total payment count: Fixed value 01 for Total payment count sub-table.

Sub-Table ID (Payment Type 02): Sub Table ID fixed value 02 identifying Payment Type sub-table.

TransArmor-Verifone Edition processing is exempt from full card-read data storage restriction.

Sequence Indicator (Sub-Table 08): Indicates sequence of transactions when multiple installment payments are submitted, ascending order.
MIT/CIT Category and Subcategory Data (Sub-Table 09): Indicates category/subcategory data for Cardholder Initiated and Merchant Initiated transactions.
Recurring Payment Type: Sub-table 12 field specifying recurring payment type for Visa transactions.

Soft Descriptor - Merchant City: Merchant city; for Discover, holds underlying retailer's city for Third Party Payment providers.
Soft Descriptor - Merchant State: Merchant state; for Discover, holds underlying retailer's state for Third Party Payment providers.

Host message should only contain Account Number and Expiration Date (YYMM) in Card Discretionary Block Data field.

Sub-Table Data: Variable data content for a sub-table, max length 25 bytes.
Account Updater Request Indicator (Sub-Table ID 01): Indicates whether merchant can accept updated cardholder account info from First Data.
Account Update Request Indicator: Indicates whether to send all account update info (Y) or only indicators (I).
Auth Optimization Override Indicator: Indicates whether merchant wants to override First Data Auth optimization services.
Customer Additional Information Table ID: Table ID fixed value 062 for Customer Additional Information Data.

Customer Additional Information Table Data: Indicates whether Cardholder Additional Data is present, containing sub-table IDs.
Cardholder Phone Number: Sub Table ID 01 within Customer Additional Information Data representing cardholder phone number.
Cardholder Phone Number (Sub-Table ID 01): Cardholder phone number for account verification transaction, Visa only.

Cardholder Email Address (Sub-Table ID 02): Cardholder email address for account verification transaction, Visa only.
Arrival Date: Arrival date in MMDD format for Visa Incremental Auth Lodging Data.

Terminal Transaction Number: Unique number tracking partial reversals and incomplete authorizations for Lodging/Incremental Auth/EV.
Preferred Customer Indicator: Field value P indicates preferred customer, used in Visa Incremental Auth example.
Service Location Information: Table ID 064, variable length up to 49 bytes, for MasterCard/Maestro Debit transactions.

Service Location Country Subdivision Code: State/subdivision code for service location, required if different from acceptor subdivision code.
Service Location Country Code: Identifies Service Location Country Code sub-table.
No other Card Discretionary Data field follows the 4-digit Expiration Date for Debit Completions, Reversals, and Cancellations.
Service Location Country Code: Present when different from location identified in Acceptor Country Code.
Service Location Postal Code: Present when different from Acceptor Postal Code, formatted per country postal standards.
Merchant Payment Gateway ID: Identifies Merchant Payment Gateway for MasterCard/Maestro transactions.

Digital Commerce Domain Identifier (Sub-Table 01): Identifies entity responsible for populating digital commerce solutions indicators.
Digital Commerce Program Type (Sub Table 02): Indicates type of digital commerce program, e.g. NextGen POI, Multi-Program, In-Store Biometric.

Anticipated Completion Amount: Table ID 070, anticipated completion amount sent in debit authorization requests.
Enabler Verification Value: Table ID 071, fixed length value of 005.

Transaction Link Identifier: Fixed value 072, variable length up to 22 bytes for MasterCard/Maestro transaction linking.
Future Transaction Amount: Fixed value 073, indicates anticipated amount of a future completion transaction.
Discount Program Data: TLV-formatted field identifying Visa Merchant Discount Program data.
Discount Line-Item Data: Field header for Discount Line-Item Data, table content not shown on this page.

aiToTest.statement: Discount Rate-Percentage: Discount rate in percentage with two implied decimal places.

Flat Discount Rate: Flat discount rate for the product code, numeric padded with leading zero.
Total Discount Amount: Total discount amount for the line item, numeric padded with leading zero.
Net Fuel Price: Net line item amount less taxes exempted or discounts, four decimal places implied.

Product Code: Numeric, 3-digit product code received from POS, with leading zeros.
Product Length: Numeric 3-digit length field for product line item group.
Sub-Table ID: Identifies sub-table type, e.g. 01=Service Type, 02=Product Category/Description.

Sub-Table Data (Product Category/Description): Contains product category or detailed description; optional for fuel transactions.
Taxable Indicator (Sub Table ID 03): Indicates whether item is taxable: 0=False, 1=True.
Local Tax Included Indicator: Indicates whether unit cost includes local tax; 1=True.
Local Tax Amount: Amount of local tax when Local Tax Included Indicator = 1, two decimals implied.
Local Tax Rate: VAT/local tax rate percentage for fuel purchased, two decimals implied.
Other Tax Included Indicator (Sub Table ID 10): Indicates whether unit cost includes national tax; 1 = True.
Other Tax Amount (Sub Table ID 11): Amount of other tax when tag 10 = True, two decimal places implied.
Other Tax Rate (Sub Table ID 12): Other tax rate percentage for fuel purchased, two decimal places implied.

Other Tax Included Indicator: Sub-table indicating whether unit cost includes national tax, 1=True.

Table ID (Cardholder Additional Information Result Code): Fixed value 035 identifying the Cardholder Additional Information Result Code table.
Table Length (Cardholder Additional Information Result Code): Length field, 3 bytes, for Cardholder Additional Information Result Code table.
Table Data (Cardholder Additional Information Result Code): Maximum 50 bytes; indicates presence of Cardholder Additional Information result code sub-tables.
Sub-Table ID '01': Fixed value 01 identifying Cardholder Account Name result codes sub-table.
Sub-Table Length (Sub-Table 01): Fixed value 03 indicating length of Sub-Table Data for Sub-Table 01.
Sub-Table Data (Sub-Table 01, Cardholder Name Result Codes): 3 bytes of Visa name match decision codes for First, Last, Middle name.
Sub-Table ID 02 (Cardholder Phone result code): Sub-table identifying Cardholder Phone result code, fixed value 02.
Sub-Table ID 03 (Cardholder Email result code): Sub-table identifying Cardholder Email result code, fixed value 03.
Account Type (Table Data, Table ID 036): Identifies the 'from' account type received from network, applicable to Visa only.
Account Funding Source (Table ID 037): Additional Information sub-table for Account Funding Source, Table ID fixed value 037.

Fraud Score Reason Code: Reason code explaining fraud score in table ID 040, max length 2.
Authentication Data Quality Indicator: Table ID 042, fixed length 001 field for authentication data quality.

Token Update First Use Indicator: Indicates first use of network token since PAN or expiration date update.

Applied Special Service: Table ID 045, indicates eligible authentication/data sharing method used, included if subfield 27 = Y.

Visa Decline Response Category Code (Table Data, Table ID 047): One-byte field indicating category of a Visa declined response code (1-3).
Variable Information: Contains National Point-of-Service Condition Codes, Table ID 030.
Terminal Class: Sub-component of National Point-of-Service Condition Codes occupying positions 1-3.
Presentation Type: Sub-component of National Point-of-Service Condition Codes occupying positions 4-7.
Security Condition: Sub-component of National Point-of-Service Condition Codes occupying position 8.
Terminal Type: Sub-component of National Point-of-Service Condition Codes occupying positions 9-10.

Position Nos. 4-7 (Presentation Type): ISO values indicating presentation type such as customer/card presence or preauthorized purchase.
Security Condition: Indicates security condition of the transaction such as fraud suspicion or verified identification.
File Name: Identifies the type of file, fixed value CA_KEYS.
File Version: Specifies the file version for tracking purposes.
Expiry Data: Specifies when the key expires, format MMDDYYYY.

Transmission Number: Sub-field of SPDH Header Table Data, numeric.

Filler: Filler field within SPDH Header Table Data.
Local Date/Time: Local date and time field within SPDH Header Table Data.
Message Type: Message type sub-field within SPDH Header Table Data.
Message Subtype: Message subtype sub-field within SPDH Header Table Data.
Transaction Code: Numeric transaction code sub-field within SPDH Header Table Data.
Processing Flags: Numeric processing flags sub-field within SPDH Header Table Data.
Base24 Response Code: Numeric Base24 response code sub-field within SPDH Header Table Data.
Moneris Language Indicator: Language indicator table data using Moneris language matrix values 3-6.

Ship-from Postal Code format is PROVISIONAL (P-01): strict US ZIP+4 or general alphanumeric up to 10 characters; non-conforming values are flagged for SME review rather than hard-rejected.
Direct Marketing Invoice Number is alphanumeric, max 10 characters, when populated.
Employee Number follows approved authorization policy when present
Password follows approved authorization policy when present
Totals Date uses a permitted source-defined request code

Hardware Version is required
Software Version is required
Firmware Version is required
Currency Code is optional when allowed by the message context
Loyalty Program ID, required, is numeric with maximum length 6
Loyalty Account Number, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 24
Points to Redeem, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 6
Coupon ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 19
Coupon Amount, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 8
Update Code, when populated, is exactly one alphanumeric character from the documented set A, C, E, I, P, S, T, U
Street Address, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 5
Phone Number, Loyalty, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
Expiration Date, when populated, is numeric length 4 in MMYY format; device sends default 1249 when no expiration date is present on the card
Payment Tender Type is required, exactly 2 alphanumeric characters from the documented set AX, CK, CS, DB, DN, DS, EB, EC, FL, GC, JC, MC, PC, PR, VS
Loyalty Track 2 Data, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 38
Loyalty Information Version, when populated, is numeric length 1 with valid values 1 or 2; defaults to 1 when not sent
Unit of Work, when populated, is numeric with fixed length 19; required on loyalty reversals to match the original purchase
Block Number is required and three numeric characters
Text Data Length, when populated, is three numeric characters and represents Text Data length
Indicator length
Variable information length
Additional Information Indicator (Element 116) identifies the type of additional information being transmitted
Additional Information Length (Element 117) identifies the length of the following Additional Information (Element 118)
Additional Information (Element 118) is variable length and carries the value identified by its paired Indicator/Length
ECA/TeleCheck® Clerk ID, required, is alphanumeric with maximum length 6
ECA/TeleCheck® Product Code, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 6 and has no documented enumeration (free-form, merchant/risk-control defined)
